lore.short: A young king that led the people of Mahar Pura to victory against invaders.

skills.name: Mark of the King
skills.description: Minsitthar's Basic Attacks and skills apply a stack of Mark of the King, up to 5 stacks. Upon reaching max stacks, the next attack detonates all Mark of the King stacks, dealing Physical Damage equal to 400 (+6% Max HP) of Minsitthar's Max HP and stunning the target for 0.8s while healing Minsitthar for 400 (+6% Max HP) HP. Can only trigger once every 6s on the same target.

skills.name: Spear of Glory
skills.description:
Minsitthar thrusts the Spear of Glory forward, dealing 175 (+40% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage and slowing enemies hit by 30%. Enemy heroes hit by the spear tip are stunned for 0.3s.

After a short delay, Minsitthar pulls the spear back, dealing 175 (+40% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage to all enemies in its path and pulling enemy heroes toward him. Pulled heroes are stunned for up to 0.8s based on the distance pulled.

skills.name: Shield Assault
skills.description: Minsitthar awakens the power in his shield and releases it, dealing 100 (+45% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage to all enemies in a rectangular area and slowing them by 80% (decaying rapidly over 2s). Meanwhile, he enters Phalanx state for 3s, reducing damage taken from the front by 25% and enhancing his Basic Attack to swiftly strike an area in front of him for 100 (+45% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage per hit.

skills.name: King's Calling
skills.description:
Minsitthar charges forward and calls 4 Royal Guards to form a field around him. The Royal Guards cannot move but will attack enemies in the field and deal  (+30% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage to them.
Enemies in the field are slowed by 30% and cannot use movement skills.

assist.desc: Minsitthar works best with high damage Marksmen, such as Melissa and Hanabi, because he can create more opportunities for them to deal damage.

strong.desc: Minsitthar is strong against heroes that rely on mobility skills since his Ultimate disables them. Minsitthar can instantly negate the advantages of heroes like Lancelot, Benedetta and Arlott.

weak.desc: Minsitthar is countered by heroes with high Movement Speed, such as Zilong and Aulus, who can easily dodge his 1st Skill and run out of his Ultimate.
